Welcome to Fernhurst Junior School
At Fernhurst, we believe that every child deserves an inspiring education, a strong sense of belonging and the confidence to achieve their very best. Our motto, Together Towards Success, captures everything we stand for. By working in partnership with children, families, staff and our wider community, we create an environment where everyone is encouraged to flourish.
The junior years are an incredibly important stage of a child’s education. These four years are filled with opportunities to grow academically, socially and personally, and we are committed to making every day count. We want our children to leave Fernhurst not only with excellent knowledge and skills, but with the resilience, curiosity and self-belief that will prepare them for the next stage of their journey and for life beyond school.
Our curriculum is ambitious, engaging and carefully designed to inspire a lifelong love of learning. We encourage children to ask questions, think critically, embrace challenges and discover their individual talents. Success looks different for every child and we celebrate effort, perseverance and personal achievement just as much as academic excellence.
Relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We know children thrive when they feel safe, respected and valued. Our dedicated staff take the time to know every child as an individual, building positive relationships that nurture confidence, kindness and a genuine sense of belonging. We are equally proud of the strong partnerships we build with parents and carers, recognising that the greatest success comes when we work together.
Life at Fernhurst extends far beyond the classroom. Whether through sport, music, the arts, leadership opportunities, educational visits or our wide range of enrichment activities, we want every child to discover new passions, create lasting memories and develop the confidence to make a positive difference in the world around them.
We are incredibly proud of our Fernhurst family and the caring, ambitious culture we have created together. If you are already part of our community, thank you for your continued support. If you are considering Fernhurst for your child, I warmly invite you to visit us and experience our school for yourself. Nothing compares to seeing our children learning with enthusiasm, showing kindness to one another and demonstrating the confidence that comes from feeling happy, supported and challenged.
I look forward to welcoming you to Fernhurst Junior School and working Together Towards Success.

pageCache.pageTitle: Report an Absence – Fernhurst Junior School, Southsea, Hampshire, UK
pageCache.text:
Regular Attendance at school is vital if pupils are to make the most of the opportunities Fernhurst has to offer and for their future. We know that there is a direct link between good attendance and good progress.
Family holidays should not be taken during term time.
If you feel your child is not well enough to come to school please telephone the office on the first day of absence and every day after that, until the child returns.
If a child has a medical appointment, please send them to school and collect them after registration. It is also important to return children to school after appointments so that they are here for afternoon registration and lessons.
We are happy to supervise the administering of medicine if parents have given us their written consent, this can support your child to return to school. To do this please come to the office and complete a short medical consent form.
Thank you for your support in these procedures.

pageCache.pageTitle: Curriculum – Fernhurst Junior School, Southsea, Hampshire, UK
pageCache.text:
Our Curriculum
At Fernhurst we have an evolving curriculum that builds on knowledge and skills as pupils move up the school. We wish to provide pupils with a relevant, varied and aspirational curriculum, which is ambitious for our pupils and will motivate and enthuse pupils as they learn. We aim to exploit cross curricular links and make full use of our local environment to further enhance our pupils learning journey.
We follow the Hampshire syllabus for RE ‘Living Difference IV’.

pageCache.pageTitle: Extended Care and Activities – Fernhurst Junior School, Southsea, Hampshire, UK
pageCache.text:
Fernhurst pupils can benefit from both a Breakfast Club and an After School Club, on site, at our Community Lodge.
Breakfast Club The Breakfast Club is run by Devonshire Infant School and is open from 7.00am to 8.45am. Sessions cost £5.00 including breakfast. Please email devonshirekc@gmail.com for more information.
After School Club ‘Heidelbugs’ After School Club is open every school day, from 3.00pm to 5.45pm. Sessions cost £8.50 a day (this will increase to £10.00 a session from September 2025). It is well resourced, offering a variety of activities from outside games, to cookery and arts and crafts. There is also an ICT room for children to do their homework independently and the club meets full use of the school garden. Fees are £8.50 per session and includes a small snack. You are very welcome to visit the club, or call into the school office for an application pack.
Telephone: 02392 823837
Email : heidelbugs@fernhurst.portsmouth.sch.uk

Neurodevelopmental Support
A Family Assist neurodiversity platform is now available. It contains resources, guidance, and information that can be used alongside the neurodiversity profiling tool, which provides a holistic view of a child or young person’s needs, as well as strategies that can be put in place to help manage those needs in different areas of life – such as at home, at their early years setting, school or college, and in the community.
To access the platform, visit www.solent.nhs.uk/familyassist
and click the ‘Neurodiversity’ tab on the menu.
Learn more about the neurodiversity profiling tool on the Portsmouth Local Offer website.
